brief:
Qatar reaffirmed its commitment to mediating a Gaza ceasefire agreement, Shehab Wire reported, as diplomatic efforts continue to implement a halt to hostilities. The country maintained that it is working to broker negotiations between parties to the conflict.

Qatar cautioned against Israel using military escalation to achieve political gains, warning that such tactics undermine ceasefire prospects. The mediation push comes amid continued tensions and competing objectives among parties involved in the conflict.

title: Qatar pursues ceasefire mediation as Israel escalates in Gaza
